reviews.title: Good Plans, Easy to Use
reviews.text:
This app is a good start for people who are looking to get into working out or back into it. It takes all the hard work of putting together good workout plans and just lets you get straight to business! 

For the developers, you should make each days workout accessible from the locked screen to update weight and reps and each workout for that day. It would make things easier and faster instead of constantly having to go back to the app.

reviews.title: Finally
reviews.text:
I used to be a gym rat and was always in awesome shape. Slim-medium build...... cuts and definition. Everything was great till I became self employed and worked 70hrs a week. I tried numerous times for the commitment of going to the gym..... good luck with that!! For15 years I tried and started over and over at gyms,never exceeding more than a 3-4 week consistently.then I tried this GET FIT APP!!!! I finally found the THING that works for ME! I actually looked forward to working out,by myself.....5 days a week Everyone around me noticed with in 4 weeks.... dead serious! And it motivated me more. Now I could work out at 4-5-6-7-8-9:00PM, and not running to the gym. 6 months later I’m just blessed to be in my best shape in 15 years! My girlfriend actually started with me!!! Now she wanders down to basement and works out at her convenience also. I’m 52 in a month and4 day and I got my abs back!! TRUE!!! If you are CONSISTENT with this program,you will get results! This is my experience.... good luck everyone!

I never sent this accidentally 2-1/2 years ago!!! I’ve been dedicated ever since back then. I just turned 55 last week 8/6/70 Gen-X baby.  I’m in excellent shape. My midsection is developed and looking great. Everyone around me is amazed with the results and dedication I’ve had with this program !!! I also started intermittent fasting 1-1/2 years ago. That was the icing on the cake!!!  This program WORKS ONLY IF YOUR SERIOUS about your health and fitness!!!!! No weights required!!!! I’ll never stop!!!!

reviews.title: MikeS
reviews.text: I subscribed for a year and while the exercises are good and well presented, for the price I expected more. It’s a static app that doesn’t allow any deviation from fixed programs, which can be obtained for free on YouTube.  A good enhancement would be the ability to pick exercises and create or modify your daily program.   Also a nutrition interface would be nice.   I am not renewing as the value for money is not there.
